invariants.rationale: The method returns the result of HoodieListData.eager(Collections.emptyList()), which should never be null.
The returned data is based on Collections.emptyList(), so the resulting HoodieData should be empty.
As the method constructs the HoodieData from Collections.emptyList(), the size should be zero.
The static method HoodieListData.eager returns an instance of HoodieListData.
